options.opa: It induces the synthesis of glycogen in response to an increase in glucagon in the blood.
options.opb: It is a membrane protein that is activated in response to an increase in circulating GTP.
options.opc: It is activated through the cAMP produced in response to an increase in adrenaline in the circulation.
options.opd: It inhibits the lipolysis of triacylglycerides accumulated in adipose tissue, in response to an increase in intracellular cAMP.
options.ope: It is a monomeric protein that inhibits the synthesis of ATP and muscle contraction.
